name: Silent Kocmoc
author: Lekz & blizzard0692

placementContext.reason: Silent Kocmoc is expected to claim the Top 1 spot due to its relentless wave sections, near frame-perfect timings, and extreme stamina requirements that push Geometry Dash’s current skill ceiling beyond existing top demons.

description: A terrifying fusion of Silent Clubstep’s impossible legacy and KOCMOC’s brutal modern gameplay, Silent Kocmoc delivers overwhelming intensity, precision, and atmosphere, making it one of the most anticipated upcoming extreme demons.
song: t a t u by AXIUS LINK
